verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams organizes conversations into named channels with a channel-message API (ms-teams-docs-11/21) and automation of channels/conversations (ms-teams-docs-8/9/10), implying the intended channel/thread structure. However, hands-on community reports directly contradict the usability of this threading for catch-up: users describe threading as 'beggars belief' and a reason for switching to Slack (ms-teams-comm-17), no threading in DMs and inconsistent UI (ms-teams-comm-9), and confusion following threads in the chat window (ms-teams-comm-12), plus inability to search within a channel (ms-teams-comm-11). Missing for 10: first-party UX documentation specifically on thread readability/catch-up features, and independent evidence resolving the threading usability complaints.
